page_title: LIL 2-0 NAN | Lille v Nantes 20/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+7' Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) displays brilliant awareness inside the box to pounce on the rebound. From a difficult position he directs a header towards the middle of the net, but Remy Descamps pulls off a decent save to deny him.

90+3' 2 - 0 Adam Ounas (Lille) controls the ball on the edge of the box after a superb low pass by Ivan Cavaleiro. He makes a yard for himself and fires a wonderful strike into the left side of the goal via the woodwork. 2:0!
90+2' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) fails to convert the free kick after the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
90+1' Here is a change. Angel Gomes is going off and Paulo Fonseca gives the last tactical orders to Carlos Baleba (Lille).
90+1' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90+1' The manager makes a subsitution with Yusuf Yazici (Lille) coming on for Jonathan David.
89' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the free kick from Adam Ounas (Lille).
88' A free kick to Lille.
88' The Lille players’ joy was short-lived as the original decision is reversed after a VAR review by referee Pierre Gaillouste. NO PENALTY!
87' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for Lille as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
86' Stredair Appuah (Nantes) brings an opponent down and Pierre Gaillouste interrupts the game. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to Lille!
85' Lille take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

85' Jonathan David (Lille) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The ball is out of play. Lille win a corner kick.
84' The goal by Nantes won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
84' The Nantes players halt their celebrations as referee Pierre Gaillouste makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
82' Goal! Stredair Appuah (Nantes) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 1:1.
82' Nantes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

81' Marquinhos (Nantes) attempts to threaten the opposition goal with the direct free kick. He unloads a thunderbolt strike directed to the right side of the goal. The goalkeeper stretches and makes a superb save! The ball goes out for a corner. Nantes can continue in their attacking effort.
81' Remy Cabella will be replaced by Leny Yoro (Lille).
78' Alexsandro (Lille) is being sent off by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier!

75' Kader Bamba (Nantes) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Lucas Chevalier to get hold of the ball.
74' Nantes take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
72' Here's the change. Moses Simon leaves the pitch and Kader Bamba (Nantes) comes on as a substitute.
72' It is time for a substitution. Marquinhos (Nantes) is on for Douglas Augusto.
71' It’s time for the cooling break for the players to take on some fluids. It’s hot out there!
71' Paulo Fonseca has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ivan Cavaleiro (Lille) replacing Edon Zhegrova.
70' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Hakon Arnar Haraldsson walks off the pitch to be replaced by Adam Ounas (Lille).
70' The corner by Edon Zhegrova (Lille) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

69' Remy Descamps pulls off a great save to deny Remy Cabella (Lille) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far! The referee blows his whistle, Lille are awarded a corner kick.
68' Nantes fail to score from a corner as Lucas Chevalier (Lille) leaps to collect the ball.
66' 1 - 0 Goal! Jonathan David (Lille) was in the right place at the right time to pounce on the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball home. It's 1:0.
65' Pierre Aristouy prepares a substitution. Marcus Coco is replaced by Stredair Appuah (Nantes).
64' Florent Mollet comes off the pitch to be replaced by Samuel Moutoussamy (Nantes).

63' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. But his low attempt from just outside of the box went straight towards the middle of the goal and Remy Descamps made a comfortable save.
61' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
61' Marcus Coco (Nantes) was too forceful with his tackle and Pierre Gaillouste interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Free kick. Lille will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
59' Alexsandro (Lille) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.

58' Moses Simon (Nantes) brilliantly evades multiple challenges and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal. It's a weak effort, however, and is easily saved by Lucas Chevalier.

56' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
53' Remy Cabella (Lille) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
53' Benjamin Andre (Lille) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked. Lille have been awarded a corner kick.
50' Bafode Diakite (Lille) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Pierre Gaillouste saw the whole situation.
50' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
47' Jean-Charles Castelletto (Nantes) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
46' Remy Cabella (Lille) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Pierre Gaillouste signals.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

45+2' Remy Cabella (Lille) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Lille have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
45+1' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Pierre Gaillouste stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Jonathan David (Lille) is found in space by a decent pass, and he immediately hits a rocket of a shot at goal that clips the top of the crossbar.
42' A dangerous looking corner kick from Edon Zhegrova (Lille) is cleared to safety by the defence.

42' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) bursts into the box and pulls the trigger, but he can't beat the goalkeeper. He directed his shot towards the left post, but one of the defenders reacted brilliantly to block it. The linesman makes the right call and Lille will have a corner.
38' Marcus Coco (Nantes) dribbles into the box, but Lucas Chevalier is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
37' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) is flagged for offside.
35' Alexsandro (Lille) makes a rough challenge and Pierre Gaillouste blows his whistle for a foul.
34' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) unleashes a sharp shot from the free kick that sails not far wide of the left post.
32' Nicolas Pallois (Nantes) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
32' Douglas Augusto (Nantes) is penalised for a foul. Pierre Gaillouste had a clear view and blows his whistle.
31' Remy Cabella (Lille) produces a cross from the resulting free kick from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper smothers the ball.
30' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Lille.
29' Benjamin Andre (Lille) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Jonathan David, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Nantes will have a goal kick.
28' Ronael Pierre-Gabriel (Nantes) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Pierre Gaillouste no option but to blow his whistle.

27' Marcus Coco (Nantes) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lille.
24' The referee blows for a cooling break.
23' A quickly taken corner by Nantes.
22' Moses Simon (Nantes) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. Nantes will take a corner kick.
22' Benjamin Andre (Lille) creates a yard of space for himself and tries an effort from distance, but it's blocked.

19' Florent Mollet (Nantes) produces an accurate shot from the free kick. His promising effort flies towards the bottom right corner, but is blocked by Lucas Chevalier, who makes a fine save to keep the ball from hitting the net.
18' Bafode Diakite (Lille) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Pierre Gaillouste blows for a foul. Nantes have a free kick.
17' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Remy Descamps, who smothers the ball.
14' Alexsandro (Lille) attacks the corner from Remy Cabella in the centre of the box, but his header lacks accuracy and goes high over the bar.
14' Remy Cabella (Lille) takes the corner.
14' Ismaily (Lille) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee signals a corner kick to Lille.
13' Moses Simon (Nantes) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well wide of the left post.
12' Mostafa Mohamed (Nantes) commits a rough foul. Pierre Gaillouste stops the game and makes a call.
11' Florent Mollet (Nantes) takes the corner kick, but Lucas Chevalier reads it well and stops the effort.
11' Moses Simon (Nantes) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Nantes.
10' Remy Cabella (Lille) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Remy Descamps comes off the line to clear the ball away.
9' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Edon Zhegrova (Lille).
9' Tiago Santos (Lille) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Lille will take a corner.
5' Quentin Merlin (Nantes) fails to find a teammate across the pitch with a long ball. The linesman signals a throw-in for Lille.
4' Moses Simon (Nantes) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
3' Nantes keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Lille will kick the game off.
Pierre Gaillouste is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
